exact_equivalence_test: Canonical family alias may normalize spelling; same-universe additionally requires exact source-study/release identity or explicit continuation authority.
authority_or_provenance_required: ddm_survey_identity family normalization + source-study/release provenance + explicit universe/continuation authority
notes: family_keys_equal proves alias-family equivalence only; it does not prove same sample universe.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact instrument/study/release ID or explicit authority that releases are nonoverlapping partitions/continuations of one sample universe.
authority_or_provenance_required: source-native questionnaire/study manifest; immutable release provenance/hash
notes: Related constructs across instruments remain source-indexed unless harmonization authority exists.

exact_equivalence_test: Explicit governed country scope equality; no guessed default.
authority_or_provenance_required: canonical_country_code plus source scope authority
notes: Same construct in two countries is comparison evidence, not one respondent population.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact governed sampling geography or explicit containment/subsample relationship.
authority_or_provenance_required: sample-frame/geography authority and target-population definition
notes: Beirut, Lebanon-national, Arab-regional and global scopes are not interchangeable by closeness.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact source-native wave/release identity; aliases alone cannot merge different field periods.
authority_or_provenance_required: source-native wave identity and fieldwork provenance
notes: Different waves are distinct observation universes even when cross-wave comparison is authorized.

exact_equivalence_test: canonical_wave_key equality within one family plus proof the raw observations are the intended same wave/release.
authority_or_provenance_required: ddm_survey_identity canonical-wave mapping + raw-wave provenance
notes: Canonical-wave aliasing is a naming map, not sample equivalence.

exact_equivalence_test: Same governed fieldwork interval or explicit continuation/panel authority with temporal identity retained.
authority_or_provenance_required: field-date/source release metadata
notes: Temporal distance may be informative; it must not be erased by pooling.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact frame/population design identity or an explicit partition/continuation relation.
authority_or_provenance_required: sampling-frame and design authority
notes: Regional and national samples can overlap in target geography without being the same sample frame.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact eligibility/target-population definition equality, including age/residency/citizenship/household/person rules where material.
authority_or_provenance_required: sample design / universe definition
notes: Different target populations cannot be averaged as one empirical population merely because questions match.

exact_equivalence_test: Explicit namespace identity or positive cross-namespace person-linkage authority with stable person keys and provenance.
authority_or_provenance_required: respondent namespace manifest / panel-linkage or record-linkage authority
notes: String-equal respondent_id is insufficient.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact questionnaire item/version or explicit semantic-equivalence/harmonization authority.
authority_or_provenance_required: source-native questionnaire authority + Final R1/QSM identity where applicable
notes: Conceptual similarity and similar wording are not exact item identity.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact governed semantic target/relation identity under current source-specific authority.
authority_or_provenance_required: Final R1/QSM source implementation authority
notes: Same sample universe can still contain non-equivalent questions.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact topology/event semantics or explicit topology mapping authority.
authority_or_provenance_required: response semantics/topology authority; source-native response option authority
notes: Binary, ordinal, nominal, multiselect, ranked, routed and repeated events are not interchangeable.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact response_semantics_contract_hash/coordinate geometry or explicit cross-contract transform authority.
authority_or_provenance_required: response_scale_encoding_registry and source-specific authority hashes
notes: Same displayed labels do not prove equal coordinate meaning.

exact_equivalence_test: Same governed eligibility/routing predicate and denominator semantics or explicit harmonization.
authority_or_provenance_required: questionnaire routing/applicability authority + D08 risk-set identity
notes: A response percentage over a different risk set is a different empirical fact even in the same sample.

exact_equivalence_test: Same design/cluster/strata/selection framework or explicit composition authority for partitions.
authority_or_provenance_required: survey design metadata and sampling authority
notes: Target-population equality alone does not establish one design universe.

exact_equivalence_test: Same governed weight meaning, target estimand/calibration basis and valid coverage, or explicit cross-design transformation authority.
authority_or_provenance_required: weight provenance/design authority; raw-vs-weighted measure identity
notes: Numerically similar weights or unit defaults are not equivalence.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact original study/release hash and transformation/import lineage; explicit parent/derived/partition relationships.
authority_or_provenance_required: immutable source hashes/manifests and transformation provenance
notes: Needed to detect duplicate imports, original+derived duplicates, regional copies and pooled+constituent duplication.

exact_equivalence_test: Versioned authority names exactly which dimensions become comparable and which remain source-specific.
authority_or_provenance_required: source/question/scale/temporal harmonization authority
notes: Harmonization authorizes comparison/transformations; it does not by itself make universes identical.

exact_equivalence_test: Exact member-set or design-proven nonoverlap/containment/duplicate relation.
authority_or_provenance_required: respondent-level identity/linkage or source design provenance; populated proof when actual overlap is claimed
notes: Under no-DB law actual overlap remains unknown unless static authoritative metadata proves the relation.
